name.description: Custom display title for this section (overriding the default localized title from ui.static.yaml)

selector.description: Section selector mapping to one of the content categories (e.g., 'work_experience', 'personal_projects', 'education', 'skills', 'languages', 'referees', 'publications', 'awards', 'certifications', 'volunteering')

items.description: List of item selector handles to include or exclude. Omit to include all entries by default

labels.description: Dictionary of custom key-value layout label translations overriding defaults

__selection_type.description: Selection mode for all section item lists: 'include' or 'exclude'

sections.description: Ordered list of sections configuring the structure and contents of the CV
